items.title: FBI: Hackers target online accounts to steal nude photos
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>The FBI warns that cybercriminals are targeting adults' and children's social media and other online accounts to steal sexually explicit images or videos. [...]</article>

items.title: The Threat Hiding in Your Hiring Process: How Fake Remote Workers Get In
items.author: Sponsored by Specops Software
items.content: <article>Fake remote workers can exploit gaps between hiring checks, device delivery, and account access to enter organizations under false identities. Specops Software explains how document verification and biometric liveness checks can help organizations confirm that the person receiving access is the legitimate new hire. [...]</article>

items.title: Hackers leverage new Microsoft SharePoint exploit in attacks
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Hackers have already begun using a proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit for a critical Microsoft SharePoint vulnerability, published by cybersecurity company Rapid7 on Tuesday. [...]</article>

items.title: Signal adds new security feature to thwart man-in-the-middle attacks
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>​Signal has introduced Automatic Key Verification, a new security feature that gives users a new way to ensure their encrypted chats haven't been intercepted. [...]</article>

items.title: New Microsoft Defender 'ShieldBreak' zero-day grants SYSTEM privileges
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Nightmare Eclipse has released a new Microsoft Defender zero-day exploit named "ShieldBreak" after Microsoft released the August 2026 Patch Tuesday security updates. [...]</article>

items.title: Google says Chrome cuts 7 billion unwanted Android notifications a day to fight abuse
items.author: Mayank Parmar
items.content: <article>Google says Chrome's anti-abuse systems reduced unwanted notifications on Android by more than 7 billion per day during the first quarter of 2026. [...]</article>

items.title: DeadLock ransomware uses blockchain to resist infrastructure takedown
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>The DeadLock ransomware operation is using a decentralized infrastructure that relies on blockchain-backed services to protect its communication with victims and data-leak activity. [...]</article>

items.title: Sandworm hackers target IT pros with trojanized WireGuard VPN client
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Hackers associated with the Russian threat group Sandworm have been targeting system administrators and IT professionals through fake job offers since at least May. [...]</article>

items.title: Cisco warns of ASA and FTD VPN flaw exploited to crash devices
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Cisco is warning that a high-severity denial-of-service vulnerability in Secure Firewall ASA and Threat Defense (FTD) software is being actively exploited in attacks to remotely crash affected devices. [...]</article>

items.title: Delta probes Wi-Fi deauth attack on flight carrying DEF CON attendees
items.author: Ionut Ilascu
items.content: <article>Delta Air Lines is investigating an unauthorized Wi-Fi network that appeared aboard a flight from Las Vegas to Atlanta carrying passengers who had attended the DEF CON hacker convention. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft releases Windows 10 KB5120249 extended security update
items.author: Mayank Parmar
items.content: <article>Microsoft has released Windows 10 KB5120249 Extended Security Updates for versions 22H2 and 21H2 to fix security vulnerabilities and bugs. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft August 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 400 flaws, 3 zero-days
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Today is Microsoft's August 2026 Patch Tuesday, and with it comes security updates for a massive 400 flaws, including one actively exploited and two publicly disclosed zero-day vulnerabilities. [...]</article>

items.title: Windows 11 KB5121003 & KB5120240 cumulative updates released
items.author: Mayank Parmar
items.content: <article>Microsoft has released Windows 11 KB5121003 and KB5120240 cumulative updates for versions 25H2/24H2 and 23H2 to fix security vulnerabilities, bugs, and add new features. [...]</article>

items.title: Wesco confirms security incident after ExfilSquad claims data theft
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Global supply chain and distribution giant Wesco has confirmed in a statement for BleepingComputer that it is investigating a cybersecurity incident. [...]</article>

items.title: Mozilla updates GPG signing key for Firefox releases after exposure
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Mozilla announced today that it updated the GPG key used to sign Firefox and Thunderbird releases after it was accidentally exposed on GitHub. [...]</article>
